## Services
- House painting: Whole-home interior and exterior painting, done right.
- Trim & cabinets: Crisp trim and refreshed cabinets that change the whole room.
- Ceilings: Ceilings painted clean and even, with no drips and no mess.
- Multi-tone paint jobs: Two- and three-tone looks with sharp, clean lines.
